recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes either the optional narrative policy or the publisher table-rendering contract.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment asked about the apparent 1..1 root cardinality in the Narrative structure table and suggested making narrative mandatory; the accepted resolution was to remove the misleading root cardinality display, not to require narrative on all resources.
initial_application: Historical SVN-imported commit f5d0affc0fe3b6bd05def7efdbb6ceb5bfce725a, titled '#5219 - remove cardinality from root element in tree view', changed the old TableGenerator to render cardinality on non-resource rows with child elements only when the path is not the root.
additional_context: Narrative is active in current build scope through source/fhir.ini and source/narrative.html includes the active Narrative datatype table. The old generator file is no longer present, but the authoritative source/datatypes/narrative.xml root Narrative row has an empty Card. cell; DomainResource.text remains 0..1 with a warning-level best-practice invariant, preserving the non-mandatory narrative policy.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current build inputs already reflect the accepted root-cardinality display fix and do not contradict the work group decision.
